Jwt._comment: Development-only signing key. It is committed deliberately so a clone runs with no setup, and it is USELESS anywhere else: staging and production read Jwt__Secret from the environment and refuse to start without it.

Cors._comment: Development only. A native app sends no Origin header and needs no CORS grant at all; these entries exist so the Expo WEB build (react-native-web) can reach the API from a browser, where the same-origin policy does apply. Staging and production keep an empty allow-list.
